areas.desc: Dust-bowl arenas on the Federation's edge, where nobody asks who is signing up. The Rim Governor sponsors the league and receives its champions in person.
areas.name: The Rim League

areas.desc: Refinery-moon arenas bankrolled by the Fuel Baron, who owns every tanker the Federation flies. His circuit, his rules, his box seat.
areas.name: The Kessrow Circuit

areas.desc: Military games held in the shipyards to entertain the fleet. The Fleet Marshal awards the medals personally.
areas.name: The Halcyon Games

areas.desc: The Crown Ring, the great arena station at the heart of the Federation. The High Chancellor crowns the champions, and keeps the keys to the prison where the pilots are held.
areas.name: The Core Championship

classes.desc: Holds the line in heavy plating. Slow, but very hard to hurt.
classes.mastery_desc: allies next to a Vanguard take 15% less damage
classes.name: Vanguard
classes.passive_desc: +1 defense. Enemies that can reach the Vanguard must attack it
classes.signature_desc: Until your next turn, you and the allies next to you take half damage.
classes.trial: Vanguard Trial: Hold the Line (The Rim League)

classes.desc: Fights with fists and powered gauntlets. Punishes anyone who swings at them.
classes.mastery_desc: a normal guard against an adjacent attacker also counters for half
classes.name: Brawler
classes.passive_desc: parry counters hit twice as hard
classes.signature_desc: Until your next turn, hit back at every adjacent enemy that attacks you.
classes.trial: Brawler Trial: Knuckle Pit (The Kessrow Circuit)

classes.desc: Cracks armor and doors with breaching gear. Big single hits, slow feet.
classes.mastery_desc: ignores all of the target's Defense
classes.name: Breacher
classes.passive_desc: ignores half of the target's Defense
classes.signature_desc: Weapon strike that exposes the target and knocks it back.
classes.trial: Breacher Trial: Armoured Wall (The Halcyon Games)

classes.desc: Slips behind the enemy. Lifts credits off everyone they drop.
classes.name: Infiltrator
classes.passive_desc: a further +15% damage from behind, +3 credits per takedown
classes.signature_desc: Free action. This turn you can move through enemies and your next attack counts as from behind.
classes.trial: Infiltrator Trial: Shadow Bout (The Core Championship)

classes.desc: Sidearms and rifles on the move. Scales terrain other fighters have to walk around.
classes.name: Ranger
classes.passive_desc: +1 move; climbing costs no extra movement and can go up 2 levels in a step
classes.signature_desc: Light hit that suppresses the target: its next attack does half damage.
classes.trial: Ranger Trial: High Ground (The Rim League)

classes.desc: Hits hard from far away, and harder from above. Weak when cornered.
classes.name: Sniper
classes.passive_desc: +15% more damage for each level above the target (+30% per level in all)
classes.signature_desc: Free action, once a turn. The whole party deals 20% more damage to this enemy. You keep one mark at a time: marking another enemy moves it.
classes.trial: Sniper Trial: Long Sight (The Halcyon Games)

classes.desc: Keeps the team standing, and the only one who can bring a fallen fighter back.
classes.mastery_desc: Revive costs 2 less and brings the ally back at 70% HP
classes.name: Medic
classes.passive_desc: +3 to heals, and heals on an ally below half HP are 50% stronger
classes.signature_desc: Brings a knocked-out ally back beside you at 40% HP.
classes.trial: Medic Trial: Long Odds (The Kessrow Circuit)

classes.desc: The team's battery. Generates energy fast, feeds it to allies, and shuts enemies down with gadgets.
classes.name: Technician
classes.passive_desc: gains 2 energy a turn instead of 1, and starts with 1
classes.trial: Technician Trial: Signal Jam (The Core Championship)

text: The Federation keeps its people quiet with the Games: arena leagues on every world, broadcast to all of them.
The pilots who exposed what the Federation really is were called liars, and locked in a prison beyond the edge of the charts.
intro.title: Bread and circuses

text: Savage, Weber, Marg and Byran grew up on that lie. They know the truth, and they know nobody gets near the Federation's core leaders. Nobody except its champions.
Four circuits, four leaders. Win a circuit and the leader who sponsors it receives you in person.
intro.title: Their children remember

text: In the arena they are entertainers. Outside it they are taking the Federation apart, one core at a time.
First, decide who each of them will be.
intro.title: Play to the cameras

styles.help: Stop the moving cursor inside the zone.
styles.name: Sweep Bar

styles.help: Up to 3 quick sweeps. A miss ends the chain.
styles.name: Chain Strikes

styles.help: Enter the shown arrows before time runs out.
styles.name: Button Combo

styles.help: Memorise the arrows, then enter them once hidden.
styles.name: Memory Combo

styles.help: Hold, then release inside the zone. Don't overfill.
styles.name: Hold & Release

styles.help: Hold to charge through 3 levels. Too greedy fumbles.
styles.name: Charge Tiers

styles.help: Hammer the button to fill the power bar.
styles.name: Power Mash

styles.help: Alternate Left / Right to fill the power bar.
styles.name: Alternating Mash

styles.help: Press on each beat as the cursor crosses it.
styles.name: Rhythm Taps

styles.help: Press when the shrinking ring meets the target.
styles.name: Shrinking Ring

styles.help: Wait for DRAW!, then press as fast as you can. Too early misses.
styles.name: Quick Draw

styles.help: Steer the crosshair (arrows / WASD / mouse) to stay on the drifting target.
styles.name: Lock-On

styles.help: Two cursors cross the bar at different speeds. Press when they line up.
styles.name: Twin Sweep

styles.help: Three beats tick, then go silent. Press on the next beat.
styles.name: Blind Count

styles.help: Press the arrows round in order (up, right, down, left) as fast as you can.
styles.name: Spin Cycle

styles.help: Hold to push the needle up, let go to let it fall. Keep it in the moving band.
styles.name: Pressure Gauge

styles.help: Fake tells flash first. Strike only on the real one, as fast as you can.
styles.name: Feint

styles.help: Each press adds a random 10-30% power. Stop when you like; over 100% fizzles.
styles.name: Push Your Luck

styles.help: Press at the top of each swing to build momentum, then strike as it passes the bottom.
styles.name: Pendulum

styles.help: The shot takes a moment to land: fire before the target reaches the mark.
styles.name: Lead the Target

styles.help: Two bars, one per hand: Left stops the top one, Right the bottom. The worse hand counts.
styles.name: Dual Wield

styles.help: Hold to cook; the ticks speed up. Let go just before it blows.
styles.name: Cook the Fuse

styles.help: Mash to haul the rope in, but stop while BRACE flashes or you lose ground.
styles.name: Tug of War

styles.help: Steer through the gates in order before time runs out.
styles.name: Path Trace
